feeds.title: The Sun » Football Manager
feeds.description: The Sun.co.uk is the online edition of The Sun, Britain's largest newspaper and a member of the UK's press regulator, IPSO. In their football manager blog, they discuss the game, its latest updates, important features, new signings, manager updates and more.

feeds.title: FM Tahiti
feeds.description: Welcome to the FMTahiti blog. I'm a long-time Championship and Football Manager player who has found themselves drawn towards saves in odd, edited, databases. I also love statistics, analysis and tactics (especially goofball). Below you can browse posts about my save games in my custom Semi-Fictional French Polynesia, Football Manager and Statistics, and other stories/blogs.

feeds.title: A FM Old Timer Blog
feeds.description: A Football Manager blog with a penchant for metric analysis to assess player performance and tactical set-ups. Follow their blog about metric analysis using Football Manager to assess player performance and tactical set-ups.

feeds.title: Fuller FM
feeds.description: Welcome to Fuller FM. This is where you will find all the various stories and rambles of an average virtual football manager. If you're looking for someone who throws plastic water bottles and makes Simpsons memes instead of waffling on about complicated tactics, you've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Football Manager Addict
feeds.description: FootballManagerAddict.com is a website about the game that represents the football manager of clubs. The blog's author provides insights, tips, and analysis on how to succeed in the game and improve your team's performance.

feeds.title: Passion4FM
feeds.description: Welcome to Passion4FM.com the #1 Football Manager blog dedicated to increase engagement and knowledge throughout the whole Football Manager community.

feeds.title: theFFM
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Jenna, also known as theFFM or The Female Football Manager. I've been playing since the Championship Manager days, but I'll admit I used to cheat quite a bit back then! Now, I've learned how to play properly (well, mostly), but that doesn't mean I haven't suffered my fair share of setbacks and disappointments. Sharing my savings with others is something I've always loved to do, whether it was with friends or fellow forum members.

feeds.title: CoffeehouseFM Blog
feeds.description: 'A multi-owned site among blogging friends'. That's Coffeehousefm.com summed up in one sentence. Those involved have written about Football Managers, on their own respective sites, for a number of years. But Coffeehousefm is the next evolution; it does not have a content schedule or demands placed on its writers, it will instead allow those that have joined to be themselves. For this reason, you will encounter a mixture of stories, updates, guides and tactics all set in the fictional Universes that we call home in Sports Interactive's Football Manager games series.

feeds.title: Load FM Writes
feeds.description: The Load FM Writes blog is a dedicated space for Football Manager enthusiasts, offering a blend of tactical insights, gameplay strategies, and personal reflections on the game.

feeds.title: Real Time Football Manager
feeds.description: RTFM is a daily Football Manager blog that began in November 2012 using the FM13 engine, playing in 'real-time', and publishing in-character updates, results, match reports, tournaments, transfers.

feeds.title: The Higher Tempo Press
feeds.description: The Higher Tempo Press is a dedicated Football Manager community blog delivering in-depth tactics breakdowns, FM game insights, guides, and immersive stories for fans who live and breathe the ultimate football management sim.

feeds.title: FM Addict Blog
feeds.description: I'm the founder of FM Scout. One of the most popular fan sites dedicated to the Football Manager series. It has been a long journey of more than 16 years, full of intense moments, both good and bad.

feeds.title: Blitz Football Manager Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with all the Blitz Football Manager news and developments with our developer Manager Blog.

feeds.title: Football Manager Story
feeds.description: Follow the Football Manager Story blog and get all the news, tactics, wonderkids, guides, and downloads along with all the latest FM 23 news, tools, articles, and tips for you success.

feeds.title: MaddFM Blog
feeds.description: Football Manager blog hosted by MaddFM, Head of Blogging at WeStreamFM.com and occasional writer for Football Manager's The Byline. The blog provides information about the game, its latest editions, gameplay, tactics, tips, and more useful content.

feeds.title: FMPressure
feeds.description: I've been playing Championship Manager and Football Manager for over 20 years now. My earliest memory of it was playing on the Commodore Amiga at a mate's house around 1994/95. It was a bit old, but I thought it was great. In this blog, I talk about writing about my saves, more for notes for myself so I remember the good times (and the bad) but if people get something out of them, then that's cool. From time to time, I get into my tactics and discuss how I've set my teams up and show the style I'm using.

feeds.title: FM Stag
feeds.description: fmstag.com is a website that provides tools and resources for players of Football Manager, a popular football management simulation game. The site offers a variety of features to help players enhance their gaming experience, including information about clubs, players, tips, tactics, custom graphics, and more.

feeds.title: FM Beats
feeds.description: FM Beats is a Football Manager blog chronicling detailed career save stories—each new season brings a fresh campaign, from Panathinaikos to Portimonense to Hamburg, narrated with personality, strategic insight, and immersive storytelling.

feeds.title: FM Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Football Manager Blog! We are a community of passionate Football Manager players who have been dedicated to the game since it first launched in 2004. We share tips, tricks, and strategies for becoming a successful Football Manager manager on our blog, as well as news and updates about the latest versions of the game. We also review new clubs and players, and provide insights into the world of Football Manager.

feeds.title: Dictate The Game
feeds.description: Dictate The Game. Your home for Football Manager content, including downloads, tactics, guides, stories, and more.

feeds.title: LutterworthFox Blog
feeds.description: LutterworthFox Blog is about football manager game blog that provides all the necessary information about the game, players, clubs, management and more.
